title: The last page is unreachable when the item count is not a multiple of the page size
issue: With 25 items and 10 per page there should be 3 pages, but `paginate(list(range(25)), page=1, per_page=10).total_pages` is 2 and `paginate(list(range(25)), page=2, per_page=10).has_next` is False. Items 20 to 24 exist (asking for page 3 returns them) but nothing in the result says a third page is there, so the UI never links to it.

steps.say: I'll start with the module the issue is about.
Before changing anything I want to see what the existing tests cover.
total_pages uses floor division, so a partial last page is not counted. It needs to round up.
Running the tests again to confirm nothing that worked before is broken.

args.summary: total_pages was computed with floor division, which dropped a partial last page. It now rounds up.
